RentalProcess.title: A clear and straightforward rental process
RentalProcess.subtitle: Understand what to expect when you rent with Zippy Car Rental, from selecting your vehicle to pickup and return.

vehicleSelection.title: Select your vehicle and package
vehicleSelection.description: Choose from our Maruti Suzuki fleet and select between 12-hour and 24-hour rental packages. Each package includes a specified kilometre allowance.

packageUnderstanding.title: Understand included kilometres and charges
packageUnderstanding.description: 12-hour packages include 180 km. Additional kilometres are charged at ₹10/km. Final pricing and availability are confirmed by Zippy on WhatsApp.

pickupArrangements.title: Provide your details and confirm pickup
pickupArrangements.description: Submit your enquiry with pickup location, dates, and times. Zippy confirms availability and final details before you arrive for pickup.

confirmationNote.title: Availability and pricing confirmation
confirmationNote.description: This website helps you prepare an enquiry. Zippy confirms vehicle availability, final pricing, and booking details directly with you on WhatsApp.

RentalGuidelines.title: Simple, transparent rental guidelines.
RentalGuidelines.subtitle: Everything you need for an effortless self-drive experience in Pune. No complex paperwork or surprise clauses.

1.title: Original Documents
1.desc: Valid Indian Driving Licence (held for min. 1 year) along with original Aadhaar Card or Passport for identity and address verification.

2.title: Age & Eligibility
2.desc: Drivers must be at least 21 years of age with active driving competence. Additional drivers can be registered prior to journey dispatch.

3.title: Refundable Security Deposit
3.desc: A standard refundable security deposit is collected before handover and credited back promptly following return vehicle inspection.

4.title: Fuel & FASTag Tolls
4.desc: Return the vehicle at the same fuel level as dispatched. All cars are equipped with an active FASTag for seamless highway travel.

RentalGuidelines.whatsappPrompt: Have questions about outstation travel, security deposit, or customized multi-day rentals?

1.title: Well-maintained vehicles
1.body: Every Maruti Suzuki in the fleet is kept in excellent condition before your rental.

2.title: Flexible rental plans
2.body: Hourly and multi-day rentals available. Enquire for rates tailored to your trip.

3.title: Transparent pricing
3.body: Clear rates with no hidden charges. Price confirmed on WhatsApp before you drive.

4.title: Personal WhatsApp support
4.body: Every enquiry is answered by Zippy directly. Real answers, no bots.
